issues.detail: The Greek 'ελεγον' is an aorist active participle/verb indicating they were saying something, but the Vietnamese translation treats it as a direct quote ('nói:'). More importantly, the Greek phrase 'ελεγον αλλους εσωσεν εαυτον ου δυναται σωσαι' translates to 'saying [to one another]

The Vietnamese translation omits the specific structure of the Greek which implies they were mocking each other *while* saying it. The Vietnamese 'mà nói' (and said) loses the simultaneous/participial nature of 'ελεγον'.
